title: SidecarReport
description: Output of `info --view full --sidecar` for one input.

status.description: `written` or `unchanged` (an up-to-date sidecar was already there).

format.description: Format id of the input (absent when the sidecar was unchanged and the file not opened).

bytes.description: Size of the sidecar in bytes.

verified.description: True when a written sidecar was read back and matched.
